blocks.text: Embark on a journey of vivid colors and artistic adventures with the Crayola Pip-Squeaks Marker Set. This set includes 25 washable mini markers and 40 sheets of high-quality paper, all neatly packed in a durable art case. Designed with smaller barrels to fit comfortably in toddler hands, these markers make coloring fun and effortless for young artists. The Pip-Squeaks Markers offer the same top-tier washable ink as their full-sized Crayola counterparts, ensuring easy cleanup from skin and most washable clothing. Ideal for classrooms, school projects, and year-round creative activities, these markers are a must-have for toddler art supplies collections. Perfect for travel, the compact Crayola Pip-Squeaks Art Case ensures your toddler always has something fun to do on the go. This set makes a great Christmas gift for kids, and a delightful Easter basket essential—perfect as a cheerful Easter basket stuffer that adds creative fun to any spring celebration. Safe and non-toxic, these markers are suitable for children ages 4 and up, providing peace of mind for parents and teachers. Give your child hours of creative exploration with the Crayola Pip-Squeaks Marker Set, the perfect companion for their artistic endeavors.
